data.title: Overnight mode: pause near the usage limit, resume after the reset
read usage telemetry from the statusline sidecar
the PreToolUse gate that winds work down
the resume watcher and its scheduled wake-up
hold the machine awake while the watcher waits

data.next: measure what the platform actually puts on the statusline payload

data.claim: the hook payload does NOT carry rate_limits; only the statusline does, and a plugin cannot install a statusline
data.proof: dumped 40 PreToolUse payloads in a live session — no rate_limits key on any of them

data.text: Telemetry is therefore operator-installed and optional. Absent it the feature degrades to off and doctor says so — it must never guess usage from transcripts.

evidence.counts: sidecar written atomically, numbers and a validated session id only, never free payload strings; 14 tests, exit 0

data.next: decide the wind-down allowlist: what a paused agent may still do

data.claim: the gate must NEVER bind the supervised operator — only subagents and an unsupervised main thread. A pause that blocks the human's own interactive work is a bug, not a budget.
data.proof: first draft denied a Read in the operator's own session

data.detail: a malformed limits block in config.yaml made the gate deny every tool call — a budget nicety must fail OPEN, and this one failed closed
absent, off or malformed limits now all PASS
data.next: write the refusal checklist an agent follows when it does bind

evidence.counts: fails open on every unreadable input; checkpoint + gate + marker written on the way down; 31 tests, exit 0

data.detail: sleeping in 30-minute chunks and re-reading the wall clock, so an overslept laptop fires on the next wake
data.next: prove the double-resume race is closed

data.detail: the detached watcher does not survive a reboot, and I cannot verify a launchd plist without rebooting this machine
data.next: needs a machine I am allowed to restart, or the caveat ships documented instead of fixed

next_steps: resume T-3 when the five-hour window resets
